name: VibeWave v2.4.2
body:
### 🚀 VibeWave v2.4.2 Seamless In-App Update!

- 🔄 **Direct In-App Install (No Duplicate Files):** Ab update karne par browser nahi khulega aur na hi baar-baar duplicate download file banegi! App ke andar hi download hokar direct system update prompt open hoga!
- 🎨 **Bold & Clear Update Button:** High-contrast Royal Blue & Bold White text me sundar aur saaf button!
- ✖️ **Notification Cut / Close Button:** Upar scroll down karke direct gana band karne ka option!
- 🎙️ **Voice Search & Assistant:** Bol kar gana search karein!
